title: Nag-iba ang pension deposit ngayong October? Check muna ang 年金振込通知書
summary: Japan Pension Service is sending pension transfer notices to recipients whose October 2026 deposit changes because amounts specially withheld from pension, such as long-term-care insurance premiums, changed. Huwag agad i-assume na nabawasan ang pension entitlement: compare the official notice and deduction lines first.
why_it_matters: A lower or different bank deposit can come from changed insurance-premium or tax withholding. The official notice tells affected recipients what changed and points deduction questions to the municipality.

sources.title: 令和8年10月の年金支払いにかかる年金振込通知書を送付しています

claims.text: Japan Pension Service is sending pension transfer notices to people whose October 2026 pension deposit changes because specially withheld amounts such as long-term-care insurance premiums changed.
Questions about changes to insurance premiums or taxes specially withheld from pension should be directed to the recipient's municipality.
The October 2026 pension transfer notice becomes available for viewing and reissue request in Nenkin Net from October 9, 2026; Nenkin Net registration is required.
claims.basis: Japan Pension Service Nenkin Net schedule

claims.text: Japan Pension Service says a notice requested for reissue takes about one week to be dispatched, plus delivery time.

A different bank deposit does not by itself prove that the gross pension entitlement was reduced; affected recipients should compare the official transfer notice and its deduction information before concluding there is an error.
claims.basis: Inference from the stated reason for changed net transfers and the purpose of the transfer notice

content.key_message: Kung iba ang pension deposit mo ngayong October, check muna ang 年金振込通知書. For affected recipients, changed deductions such as long-term-care insurance premiums can change the net amount deposited.
content.who_is_affected: Pension recipients whose October 2026 transfer amount changes because amounts specially withheld from pension changed.
content.what_changed: Japan Pension Service is sending a transfer notice to affected recipients. October notice viewing and reissue requests in Nenkin Net start October 9, 2026.
content.why_it_matters: The amount that reaches the bank can change because of deductions. Looking only at the bank deposit can therefore give an incomplete picture.
content.what_to_do_now: 1) Compare the bank deposit with your 年金振込通知書. 2) Check the listed withholding/deduction information. 3) If the issue is the amount of insurance premium or tax specially withheld, contact your municipality. 4) If you need the October notice online or need a reissue, use Nenkin Net from October 9.
content.prepare: Keep the transfer notice and your bank transaction record. If using Nenkin Net, make sure your account registration is complete.
content.avoid: Huwag agad i-assume na pension entitlement mismo ang nabawasan based only on the bank deposit. Do not invent a universal expected yen change because deductions differ by person.
content.watch: If the notice and actual deposit still do not reconcile after checking the deduction information, use the official Japan Pension Service consultation route for the pension side; municipality-administered withholding questions go to the municipality.
content.bottom_line: Different October deposit? Notice first, deduction lines second, then contact the correct office. Nenkin Net access for this October notice starts October 9.
content.financial_impact: Individual; Japan Pension Service does not state one universal yen change because the relevant withheld insurance-premium/tax amounts vary.
content.risk_if_ignored: You may mistake a withholding change for a pension-calculation error or contact the wrong office.
content.deadline: No filing deadline is stated in the October 2 notice. Nenkin Net viewing and reissue requests for this October notice begin October 9, 2026.
content.effort: Low: compare the notice and deposit, then contact the municipality only if the question concerns the specially withheld insurance-premium or tax amount.
content.potential_benefit: Quickly identifies why the net pension deposit changed and routes questions to the correct authority.
content.downside: None beyond the time needed to verify the notice; a paper reissue takes about one week to dispatch plus delivery time.
content.what_would_change_mind: A later Japan Pension Service correction changing the October notice schedule, Nenkin Net start date or contact guidance.
